title: BibMedEd: An Open-Source Bibliometric Analysis Platform for Medical Education Research
description: BibMedEd unifies multi-database bibliographic search (PubMed, OpenAlex, CrossRef, Semantic Scholar, and Lens.org), automated cross-source deduplication, six bibliometric analysis modules, D3.js network visualisations, PRISMA 2020 exports, and a reproducible methodology log in a single self-hostable application. Designed for medical-education researchers conducting systematic reviews and scientometric studies.
